class.name: PuertsScriptValue
class.brief_description: Retains a value in a Puerts script environment.
class.description: Represents a value returned by [method PuertsEnvironment.eval], [method PuertsEnvironment.get_global], property reads, or function calls. [b]Lifetime:[/b] Retains the script value, but not its [PuertsEnvironment]. Keep the environment alive and use both on the same thread. Disposing or replacing the runtime permanently invalidates its wrappers. Use [method to_native] to convert to Godot values, and the property and call methods to work with script objects and functions. Operation errors are reported through [method PuertsEnvironment.set_error_callback]. [b]Type checks:[/b] Types can overlap: a JavaScript Number can satisfy both [method is_int] and [method is_float]. For invalid wrappers, all type checks return [code]false[/code] except [method is_null] and [method is_undefined], which return [code]true[/code].

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the wrapper retains a script value and its environment accepts operations.

method.name: is_null
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the backend identifies the value as null. Also returns [code]true[/code] for an invalid wrapper; check [method is_valid] first.

method.name: is_undefined
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] for script undefined or an invalid wrapper. Check [method is_valid] first.

method.name: is_bool
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] for a script boolean.

method.name: is_int
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the backend recognizes a 32-bit or 64-bit integer. This includes integer Numbers in V8 and Node.js, even though [method to_int] requires BigInt.

method.name: is_float
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the backend recognizes a floating-point number. For JavaScript Number, this includes integers.

method.name: is_string
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] for a script string.

method.name: is_binary
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] for binary data readable with [method to_binary].

method.name: is_object
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] for a script object.

method.name: is_function
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] for a script function that can be invoked with [method call].

method.name: to_bool
method.description: Reads a script boolean. Conversion of other types is backend-dependent. Returns [code]false[/code] when invalid.

method.name: to_int
method.description: Reads a signed 64-bit integer. Returns [code]0[/code] when invalid. [b]V8 and Node.js:[/b] Requires BigInt; JavaScript Number returns [code]0[/code], including integer Numbers. Use [method to_native] for automatic conversion or [method to_float] for Number.

method.name: to_float
method.description: Reads a floating-point number, including integer JavaScript Numbers. Conversion of other types is backend-dependent. Returns [code]0.0[/code] when invalid.

method.name: to_string
method.description: Reads a script string as a Godot [String]. Returns an empty string when invalid.

method.name: to_binary
method.description: Copies binary data into a [PackedByteArray]. Check [method is_binary] before reading. Returns an empty array when invalid.

method.name: to_native
method.description: Converts script booleans, numbers, and strings to Godot values and recovers wrapped Godot values. Script null and undefined become [code]null[/code]. Ordinary script objects, arrays, and functions remain [PuertsScriptValue] wrappers. Returns [code]null[/code] when invalid.

method.name: unwrap_native
method.description: Recovers the Godot [Variant] represented by a native wrapper, such as a Godot object passed to the script. Returns [code]null[/code] for ordinary script values, invalid wrappers, or freed Godot objects.

method.name: get_property
method.description: Reads property [param name] as a wrapper. Missing properties follow the backend language rules. Returns [code]null[/code] on failure, including access to a freed Godot object.

method.name: set_property
method.description: Converts [param value] to a script value and assigns it to property [param name]. A [PuertsScriptValue] must be valid and belong to the same environment.

method.name: call
call_method
method.description: Looks up function [param name] and calls it with [param args], using this value as the receiver. Arguments follow the conversion rules of [method call]. Returns a result wrapper, or [code]null[/code] if the property is not callable or the operation fails.
